scope: Full MARS algorithm article only; no completion claim for DES, 3DES, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation, key management, implementations or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 MARS 这一种 128 位块、32 轮的 AES 候选分组密码：8 轮前向混合、16 轮核心轮、8 轮后向混合、E 函数、512 字 S-box、修订后的 40 字密钥扩展与位级修正、128-448 位密钥、作者提供的 IVT/VK/VT/TBL 向量；不把 DES、3DES、AES、其他 AES 候选者、工作模式或整个库并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the 128-bit-block, 32-round MARS AES candidate: 8 forward-mixing rounds, 16 core rounds, 8 backward-mixing rounds, the E function, the 512-word S-box, the revised 40-word key expansion and bit-level fixing, 128-448-bit keys, and the author-supplied IVT/VK/VT/TBL vectors. It does not absorb DES, 3DES, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation or the whole library.

entry.relatedPolicy: These are distinct catalog entities. They are linked for context only and are not aliases, merged identities or completed by this article. DES and 3DES are historical motivation and comparison targets, not components of MARS; AES is the final standard, Twofish and Serpent are other AES candidates.
